Looping infra/ops notes into thread so sales has a concrete plan.

Short answers and constraints:
- Lead time: for dedicated A100-equivalent reserved slots we need ~6 weeks once PO is firmed and payment terms agreed. If Nimbus is flexible to accept H100-backed variants we can reduce procurement latency to ~3-4 weeks due to existing inventory.
- Density: 40 A100 slots ≈ 10 physical GPUs if we assume 4 slots per A100 (depends on model memory & quantization). If they want spike/burst headroom (20%), recommend a 2-week burst buffer held as pre-allocated burst credits rather than sustained reserved capacity.
- Risk: Q3 has multiple large pilots; recommend hedging by committing 70% of their ask as reserved (28 slots) and offering a priced burst bucket for the remaining 30% (12 slots) to avoid over-committing hardware.

Action items for this week (ops + finance + sales):
1) Sales: confirm GPU family preference and exact start date with Nimbus (Chloe).
2) Finance: provide proposed invoice terms for 28-slot reserve + burst credits pricing (Laura).
3) Infra: validate node mappings and put tentative hold on inventory for the 6-week path; list fallback H100 alternative and expected perf delta (Karthik).

Ben
Head of Capacity Planning

Thanks everyone — I drafted a short invoice/commit structure to match Ben's hedged recommendation. I attached a one-pager pricing summary (we will push the detailed SOW into the DocuSign bundle once GPU family is confirmed).

Key commercial proposal (draft):
- Reserved: 28 slots (A100-equivalent) for 90 days — prepaid monthly with 30-day invoice terms.
- Burst credits: priced as a paid top-up at 1.25x base token rate for consumed burst tokens up to 12 additional slots. Credits expire at pilot end.
- Cancellation: 30-day notice, early termination pro-rate per MRA language.

Questions for Nimbus:
- Can procurement confirm GPU family by Apr 16? We need that to finalize the SOW and lock node mapping.
- Finance: are they able to do net-30 on the initial reserve? If not, we can propose a 50% upfront plus 50% on delivery schedule.

Next steps assigned:
- Chloe: confirm Aisha's GPU preference & start date (by EOD Apr 14).
- Ben: hold tentative inventory for both A100 and H100 paths and share expected perf delta matrix (by Apr 16).
- Karthik: prepare a short runbook for node provisioning + expected setup time (by Apr 19).
- Marissa: coordinate with Sales Ops to open the DocuSign deal and HubSpot entry (deal id NIM-2026-04-12-42).

I'll attach the draft invoice and send to procurement once we have the GPU confirmed.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
